recognition_trigger: When words must be grouped by identical character composition regardless of order, each word needs a systematic canonical representation.
corrected_rule: Build a fresh 26-position frequency array for each word, convert it to a tuple, and append the word to the hashmap bucket for that tuple.
why_failed: Without a complete canonical key, equivalent words cannot be grouped reliably while distinct character-frequency profiles remain separate.
application: After processing the first i words, every processed word appears exactly once in its tuple-keyed bucket, with no word lost or duplicated; later words either join the matching bucket or create a new one. For arc, car, elbow, below, and state, the buckets are [arc, car], [elbow, below], and [state].
